source.name: Aston Villa FC – 'Aston Villa announce Visit Rwanda partnership'
source.note: The club's own announcement: Visit Rwanda on the front of all men's, women's and academy teams' shirts.
source.quote: Visit Rwanda’s branding will appear on the front of all men’s, women’s and academy teams’ shirts

source.name: Aston Villa FC – 'Aston Villa shirts to feature Visit Rwanda branding'
source.note: Retail-shirt article: adult shirts carry Betano on the sleeve after the Kaizen Gaming extension. It does not name the women's team specifically; see the pull request.
source.quote: Adult shirts will also feature Betano on the sleeve going forward

summary: Rwanda's government takes the front of the Aston Villa Women shirt; Betano is on the sleeve of adult retail shirts.

change.text: Worse than last season: Visit Rwanda took the front
